title: The 100th club meeting
observableEvidence: Combines an event interval with an ordinal position, then uses a remainder modulo 7 to determine the weekday.
prompt: A puzzle club holds a meeting every 9 days. Its 1st meeting is on a Wednesday. On which day of the week will its 100th meeting be?
solutionRepresentation: From the 1st meeting to the 100th there are 99 intervals. The elapsed time is 99 × 9 = 891 days. Dividing 891 by 7 leaves a remainder of 2, so the weekday advances two days from Wednesday to Friday.
solutionMethod: Convert the ordinal meeting number to the number of elapsed intervals, multiply by the 9-day interval, then reduce the elapsed days modulo 7.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept any capitalization of the day name or choice E.

hintSteps.prompt: The 1st meeting is already on Wednesday, so reaching the 100th meeting takes one fewer than 100 intervals.
hintSteps.question: How many 9-day intervals occur from the 1st through the 100th meeting?

hintSteps.prompt: Multiply the number of intervals by 9, then divide that elapsed-day total by 7.
hintSteps.question: What remainder do you get after removing complete weeks?

hintSteps.prompt: Only the leftover days after complete weeks move the weekday forward.
hintSteps.question: Starting on Wednesday, which answer choice is reached after counting forward by your remainder?
